sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried 
 out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
Condenser Technical Specification:

The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Galal Essawy, tested by eng. 
Khaled Ahmad El-Sayed, reviewed by eng. Mostafa Mohamed Mostafa, accepted by 
general manager eng. Ahmed Abd El Rahman Ali, revised by EDEPC inspection & quality control eng. 
Nasser Bahgat, approved by eng. Mahmoud El Naqib: head sector of Ayon Mousa PS 
and certified by eng. Soliman Zaki Soliman EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general manager.

السلامة 
الاحتياطات

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل و 
 يجب أن يحمل موظفو الصيانة المؤهلون فئة السلامة المناسبة.

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير 
 مطلوب المحيطة بمنطقة العمل.

Wear safety and healthy 
 equipments as safety healthy, safety shoes, ...etc.

Closing delivery and suction 
 valves of steam side after shutdown

تأكد من بقاء مضخة المكثفات في الداخل 
 الخدمة

Be sure seal steam condenser 
 exhauster

العمل ليكون 
نفذت

Seal steam condenser &
Seal steam condenser exhauster 
in service

Check discharge quantity and 
 pressure and compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out 
 components (if it is needed).

قياس مستوى الاهتزازات ل 
 المحامل ومقارنتها بقيمة الإعداد ثم تحليلها وتحديدها 
 ماذا تفعل (إذا لزم الأمر)
Check leakage of water
التحقق من درجة الحرارة داخل وخارج
Check level & temperature

Check the pressure in seal steam 
 header ( above atmospheric ) is 35 mbar

Check any alarm in pressure and 
 temperature of seal steam margin.

sections.text:
Seal steam condenser 
& Seal steam condenser exhauster out of service :
Check cut of steam from aux. and open vacuum breaker

Check alignment and compare it with 
 the setting value.

Check bolts fixation, then 
 retightens it (if it is needed)

Clean oil by Alfa Laval and adjust 
 oil level of pump.

Check the validity of oil and add 
 or change it (if it is needed).

Check glands for leaking and 
 repacking (if it is needed).

Check the pump casing against rust 
 and repaint (if it is needed).
